test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, MUSICAL is written as NATODEM and CREATE is written as DSIEUI. How will STEROID be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• Code for consonants = positional value + 1
 
• Code for vowel = next vowel

A(1) → E(5) → I(9) → O(15) → U(15)

**MUSICAL is written as NATODEM**

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1514114270f0f4783d6f0752cba0b58f823ca41d3e005ea6aea845be54b7b0e.png] 

And,

**CREATE is written as DSIEUI**

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b89be17d5db35d95640de66e56ed482728bc6ce6643a60ce457d6de639962711.png] 

Similarly,

**'****STEROID****' be written as**

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f3cb688ac403963c3820ea0c9cb94afbac9b7851b0cbb9e1b48d9a7f52b9e02.png] 

Hence, ' STEROID' is coded as '**TUISUOE**'
